summary.headline: Dhu al-Hijjah Leap-Day Calculation
summary.text: Discussion of intercalating Dhu al-Hijjah as a thirty-day month in an approximately thirty-year lunar calendar cycle, listing leap years and explaining the accumulation of fractional days and two methods for adding the extra day.
